phase: Phase 7.0c — generic-compressor baseline ladder (raw source, gzip, zstd, xz, brotli, whole-file byte rANS, best VOLE structural candidate)
claim: On 27 locally generated corpus files (23 from the Phase-7.0 producer/synthetic corpus, 4 from the Phase-7.0b generator-family corpus), the best VOLE lane — the minimum complete serialized .voldoc size across auto, raw, rle, byte-rans, pdf-physical, pdf-channels, pdf-layout, pdf-layout-rans, pdf-deflate-replay and pdf-deflate-replay-rans — beats gzip -9, zstd -19 --long=27, xz -9e and brotli -q 11 on 0 files. The best generic compressor is smaller than the best VOLE lane on every file; VOLE is 460,320 bytes larger in total (phase7 +410,355 over 23 files; producers +49,965 over 4 files). On cairo-vector.pdf the best VOLE (34,574 B, PDF_DEFLATE_REPLAY_RANS) is 17,904 B larger than brotli -q 11 (16,670 B) and 2.07x its size; on flate.pdf the best VOLE (36,102 B) is 17,218 B larger than xz -9e (18,884 B) and 1.91x. This confirms that prior VOLE wins were relative to BYTE_RANS, a weak order-0 baseline with no LZ, and does not survive a generic-compressor comparison. All 27 auto winners verify and round-trip byte-exact; every generic result is round-trip verified. No candidate or wire format changed.
command: docker compose build baseline; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev cargo build --locked --all-features; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY -e BASELINE_CORPUS=phase7 baseline sh tools/baselines.sh <out> evidence/corpus/phase7; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY -e BASELINE_CORPUS=producers baseline sh tools/baselines.sh <out> evidence/corpus/phase7-producers
